subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team might be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev.

subject: AI rider safety models - working with Lime, Tier etc.
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Saw that your team is developing AI-based solutions to improve safety and mitigate antisocial behaviour in micromobility - imagine deploying accurate, low-latency models is becoming a pertinent issue.

Thought I'd reach out since as we're working with your ADAS / rider safety perception peers (Lime, Woven, Wayve, Tier) to help them efficiently visualise and identify edge cases within large, multimodal datasets - something they struggled with in their internal tooling setups. 

I've been following Voi's growth for a while now, so really keen to get your insights on what we're building and trade notes on what we're seeing in the space - if you're open to a quick chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.
